name: Platform-cloudflare-durable-objects lifecycle event sink
purpose: The one boundary for lifecycle event records across the facade and both DO classes. The sink is a plain function callback with a metadata-only record contract: {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp, ?objectName, ?scheduledTime}. Message bodies, request headers, cookies and PII never cross the sink; the event-secrecy probe asserts the record shape on every emitted event.
responsibilities: Constrain every emitted record to the allowed key set (AC-33106-1).
Route through the applied logging companion without a per-blueprint scrub pass.
internalStructure: A one-arg callback contract enforced by every emitter (facade, single-cell, hub). The record is a plain object built inline at every emit site; no derivation, no framework object graph.

interfaces.name: eventSink
interfaces.summary: One-arg record-write callback shared by facade and DO classes.
